STS-MS8-L3-300650-MSVPA-AGS-GBL-02 • MS Visual and Performing Arts: Music Grade 8 • Unity, Variety, and Balance in a Final Composition
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Tonight's round is called Build the Perfect Piece. Each composer is handed four instruments from four different parts of the world and three minutes to arrange them into one short piece. The judges award points for unity when an idea comes back, for variety when it changes, and for balance when no instrument buries the others.
If you could bring one instrument from anywhere in the world into your piece, which one would you choose, and where would you make it come back a second time?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
